label: Automation Custom Tool Table
description: The automation custom tool table is designed for statistical and query scenarios related to time dimensions in automated reporting.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name. This value must be unique in the database and is suitable for exact-match queries and duplicate detection.

fields.name: type_id
fields.description: Category_id. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: catalog_id
fields.description: Tool directory ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: is_lib
fields.description: Is the file in the library.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_catalog_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the catalog_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_type_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the type_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: uk_name
indexes.description: Unique index covering the name field, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
